ordered_diagnoses: Squamous Cell Carcinoma with Basal Cell Carcinoma-like Features

facts.raw_span: A 59-year-old man
crusty lesion in the right fronto-orbital region present for several months
no significant past medical history
irregularly shaped 5 × 3 cm plaque with multiple superficial crusts
Laboratory studies were unremarkable
lobules and detached aggregates of eosinophilic keratinocytes with pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli infiltrating the reticular dermis
no clear evidence of basaloid nests
invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma
focal area of uptake in the supraorbital lesion (SUVmax 6.9; metabolic tumor volume, 2 cc)
decreased uptake in the original lesion (SUVmax 4.8; metabolic tumor volume, 0.5 cc)
features typical of basal cell carcinoma
partial metabolic response
